summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 format_bytes 与 parse_bytes 两个工具，用于在字节数与常见可读单位（如 KB/MB/GB/TB）之间进行互相转换。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides two tools, format_bytes and parse_bytes, to convert between raw byte values and human-readable size formats.

capabilities: Expose `format_bytes` to convert numeric byte values into human-readable byte units.
Expose `parse_bytes` to convert human-readable size text back to a byte value.
Operate as a small DeepSeek Harness utility plugin with no declared runtime dependencies in the package metadata.
